items.title: Tokens too cheap to meter
items.title_zh: LLM token 会比 grep 调用还便宜吗？
items.title_en: Are LLM tokens about to cost less than grep?
items.summary: The article argues that LLM tokens are becoming so cheap they may soon cost less than tool calls like grep, exploring the economic and practical consequences.
